args.section_json:
{
  "conventions": [
    "Begin every newly created .ts or .tsx file with the Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026 (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).",
    "Format code with 2-space indentation, single quotes, trailing commas, and semicolons matching @backstage/cli/config/prettier.",
    "Use named exports with explicit @public or @alpha TSDoc release tags on all exported symbols re-exported from package entrypoints.",
    "Import useTranslationRef from @backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha in plugins/notifications components and consume notificationsTranslationRef.",
    "Never add data-testid attributes or use *ByTestId queries in components or tests; use accessible roles, labels, and text with screen and findBy* queries.",
    "Clean up all timers (clearInterval) and lodash throttled callbacks (.cancel()) in React useEffect cleanup functions on unmount.",
    "Only import packages declared in the respective package.json dependencies, devDependencies, or peerDependencies."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "CardExtension Progress fallback outside AppContext",
      "choice": "Wrap useApp().getComponents().Progress in a try/catch inside CardExtension and fall back to Progress from @backstage/core-components when useApp() throws",
      "rejected": [
        "Requiring callers to wrap CardExtension in TestApp",
        "Replacing app.getComponents().Progress unconditionally"
      ],
      "reason": "Preserves custom app Progress components when inside a Backstage AppContext while allowing CardExtension and createCardExtension cards to render in isolated unit tests without an AppContext."

The change specification for the home-page unread notifications card (`20261104-005757-feature-new-home-unread-notifications-card`) has been written and validated across all sections:

- **`header.json`**: Defines repository conventions, architectural decisions, per-file checks (`eslint`, `jest`), and the whole-project verification check (`CI=true yarn test plugins/notifications plugins/home-react && yarn tsc && yarn lint:all`).
- **`units-001.json` (`U01`–`U05`)**:
  - `U01`: Updates [`CardExtension`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx#L124-L202) in [plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx) to fall back to `Progress` from `@backstage/core-components` when rendered outside a Backstage `AppContext`.
  - `U02`: Adds unit tests in `plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx` verifying `CardExtension` and `createCardExtension` render without an `AppContext`.
  - `U03`–`U04`: Adds `@backstage/plugin-home-react` to [plugins/notifications/package.json](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/package.json) and updates `yarn.lock`.
  - `U05`: Adds `homeWidget` translation strings to [`notificationsTranslationRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/translation.ts#L20-L121) in [plugins/notifications/src/translation.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/translation.ts).
- **`units-002.json` (`U06`–`U10`)**:
  - `U06`–`U08`: Updates [NotificationsTable.module.css](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsTable/NotificationsTable.module.css), [`NotificationsTable`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsTable/NotificationsTable.tsx#L68-L351), and [`NotificationsPage`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsPage/NotificationsPage.tsx#L68-L255) to read `?id=<id>` from the URL, highlight the matching notification row, and clean up throttled callbacks on unmount.
  - `U09`–`U10`: Creates `plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.tsx` and its barrel `index.ts` implementing unread notification fetching, mark-as-read, deep-linking via `rootRouteRef`, live signal refresh on `notifications` channel events, and polling fallback with cleanup on unmount.
- **`units-003.json` (`U11`–`U15`)**:
  - `U11`–`U14`: Wires `HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps` and `HomePageUnreadNotifications` through [plugins/notifications/src/components/index.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/index.ts), [plugins/notifications/src/plugin.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/plugin.ts), [plugins/notifications/src/index.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/index.ts), and `HomePageWidgetBlueprint.make` in [plugins/notifications/src/alpha.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/alpha.tsx).
  - `U15`: Creates unit tests in `plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.test.tsx`.
- **`units-004.json` (`U16`–`U21`)**:
  - `U16`–`U17`: Regenerates API and Knip reports (`plugins/notifications/report.api.md`, `plugins/notifications/report-alpha.api.md`, `plugins/notifications/knip-report.md`).
  - `U18`–`U21`: Adds `.changeset/unread-notifications-home-card.md` and updates [plugins/notifications/README.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/README.md), [docs/notifications/usage.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/docs/notifications/usage.md), and [docs/notifications/usage--old.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/docs/notifications/usage--old.md).
